title: Prannoy Considers Aichi-Nagoya His Final Asian Games, LA 2028 Still Possible
indian_angle: This story focuses on the future plans of HS Prannoy, a prominent Indian shuttler, regarding his participation in major international events.
summary: HS Prannoy indicates that the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games will likely be his last, though he hasn't ruled out competing in the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics if he remains competitive.

title: Indian Shuttlers Likely to Face Japan in Asian Games Quarter-Finals
indian_angle: This article provides a crucial preview of the Indian badminton teams' potential path in the Asian Games, highlighting a tough quarter-final matchup against Japan.
summary: The Asian Games badminton draws suggest that both the Indian men's and women's teams are likely to face strong Japanese opponents in the quarter-finals after initial matches against Kazakhstan and Bangladesh respectively.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This news highlights an important coaching development program organized by BAI within India, aiming to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This reports on the national coaching camp for India's promising junior shuttlers preparing for a major continental championship.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Women’s Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update concerns the selection process for India's junior team for a prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A notification has been issued regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
